title: HeroSection.vue
content: 3D map container + UI hints. Props: frozen (boolean), zoomProgress (number), hidden (boolean). State: showZoomVignette, hasInteracted, showClickHint. Template: .hero (loader, map-container, back-button, zoom-vignette, mouse-hint, click-hint, ui-layer with header). Hint flow: Loading → MouseHint → ClickHint → Hidden.

title: AboutSection.vue
content: Slide-up info section. Props: progress (0-1), backgroundImage (string). Computed: translateY = 100 - progress*100, fadeProgress = (progress-0.8)/0.2. States: 0% below viewport, 50% starts appearing, 80% bg fades in, 95% interactive, 100% visible. Responsive design with mobile/tablet/laptop breakpoints.

title: CloudOverlay.vue
content: Cloud transition effect. 8 cloud sprites positioned Left/Right/Top/Bottom + 4 diagonals. CSS animation (GPU-optimized): --move-factor calc(1 - (var(--p) * 0.6)), transform translate3d + scale, opacity calc(var(--p) * 1.5). Uses contain:strict for performance.
